# AI coding-agent instructions for the Flushing Meadows Project

**Read and follow the repository-root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) first.** It is the canonical AI operating guidance for this project; do not replace or contradict it. Read [README.md](../README.md) and the relevant component research dossier before choosing work.

This project is a historically evidence-driven, world-first reconstruction spanning 1939, 1940, 1964, 1965 and 2026, with separately authored possible futures. Keep historical sources, inferred source geometry, optimized runtime meshes, and editable print assets distinct.

For substantive modeling, engineering and reconstruction work, **use Wolfram as the default mathematics and geometry verification resource** when connected. For game assets, rendering defects, packaging and performance, **use the installed Game Development Studio skills** when available. Use GitHub for source/code and tests, Google Drive for large versioned assets, SciSpace/archives for verified source research, and additional appropriate tools when useful. Report unavailable integrations and never claim a test or commit that did not actually occur.

Keep Cameron's creative direction authoritative. Prefer source-backed edits and testable world progress over speculative assets or redundant planning documents. Preserve existing and concurrent work; inspect fresh file SHAs before writes. Include exact paths, evidence status, tests and next steps in the handoff.
